name: form_set_props
description: Change a field's properties (General and Options tabs): name (renames it), tooltip, read_only, required, multiline, max_length (0 = no limit), options (combo/list items), font_size (0 = auto), rect (position), format, validate, calculate (Acrobat's Format/Validate/Calculate tabs, run natively: values are checked, formatted and recalculated as in Acrobat). Options tab: align (left, center, right), default (the value Reset form restores; for check boxes and radio buttons their on state, "" for off), flags { scroll, rich_text, password, file_select, spell_check, comb (needs max_length), sort, editable, multi_select, commit_immediately }, check_style (check boxes and radio buttons: check, circle, cross, diamond, square, star). Only the given ones change. Undoable.

appearance.description: Appearance tab: border, fill, text_color (#RRGGBB, a name or "none"), width (1 thin, 2 medium, 3 thick), style (solid, dashed, beveled, inset, underline), font (helvetica, times, courier).

calculate.description: Calculate tab: {"op": "sum"|"product"|"average"|"min"|"max", "fields": ["a", "b"]}, {"notation": "Price * Qty"} (simplified field notation), or "none".

check_style.description: Check boxes and radio buttons: the mark shown when on.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

locked.description: Lock the field's properties (only unlocking is accepted while locked).

rect.description: Move/resize: points from the top-left of the displayed page.

validate.description: Validate tab: {"min": 0, "max": 100} (either may be left out) or "none".
